prior_exposure: Coordinator has read the published findings; this is not preregistration or blinded validation.
user_authorization: Use publicly available NHANES data; preserve existing Markdown and append reviewed results; no new final report or HTML.
data_priority: Try documented public data reconstruction; label any single-cycle and coding-candidate analysis explicitly.
primary_assignment_estimand: Unadjusted arithmetic mean differences in each CBC-derived marker across FI quartile groups in the analyzable educational sample
primary_assignment_method: Welch ANOVA, with all ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis results reported as required method comparisons
reason: Question concerns mean levels; unequal variances plausible for skewed CBC ratios. Choice is before new data outcomes, not smallest p-value.

grouping.reference_population: All eligible participants with valid FI before marker-specific complete cases
grouping.ties: Same FI goes to same group using right-closed cuts; unequal group sizes allowed; duplicated cut points require explicit revision, no random tie splitting

comparisons.ANOVA: Tukey with its within-marker family retained
comparisons.Welch: Pairwise Welch t tests, raw p and Bonferroni/BH over all 24 pairs across 4 markers
comparisons.KW: Omnibus rank test, not automatically interpreted as medians

trend.score: FI-group median on original FI scale
trend.model: linear regression with HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust covariance
trend.report: slope, confidence interval, raw p and Bonferroni/BH over F_trend; linear association is not proof of monotonicity

missing: Use valid FI reference cohort; each marker complete-case subset with explicit n; no invented imputation
survey_extension: If appropriate MEC weight/PSU/stratum verified, provide separate design-based group means and Wald test; never label ordinary ANOVA as NHANES population inference

reproduction.model1: binary FI>.3, one log marker at a time, age/sex/race/cycle if present
reproduction.model2: Only when all reported covariate definitions and columns are verified
reproduction.log: Natural log as declared reconstruction choice; publication log base unspecified
reproduction.target_matching: No tuning to published p/OR; report discrepancy and uncertainty

sensitivity: FI definition and platelet overlap only if item-level coding verified
fractional logit only if defined FI available; a different estimand from binary OR
scope_limits: Cannot infer causal effect from cross-sectional analysis
Cannot assert exact 36-item FI replication without item coding and denominator evidence
Actual sample statistics and simulation evidence kept separate

simulation.independent_global_null: FWER=1-.95^k only for independent valid tests
simulation.dependent: separate scenario, not required to equal independent formula
